content: I have formalised some of Optimal Transport following the material in this paper - Computational Optimal Transport. I'd like to know if anything touching Optimal Transport was formalised before in mathlib, so that I don't redo what was done. I looked through mathlib and found nothing.

There is nothing. Not because it would be hard, but as is often the case, just because nobody did it. There are probably several AI formalization of it by now. There is some optimal transport in Tau Ceti for example.
